title: Types first on a new brief, inside the final-project starter

runs.name: starter-tests
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npm test -- --watchAll=false src/rentals

runs.name: starter-types
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npx expo customize tsconfig.json > /dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit
expect: Found 2 errors in the same file

runs.name: solution-tests
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npm test -- --watchAll=false src/rentals

runs.name: solution-types
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npx expo customize tsconfig.json > /dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit

runs.name: solution-lint
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npx expo lint

runs.name: solution-all
runs.cmd: cp -R src/. kit/starter/src/ && cd kit/starter && npm test -- --watchAll=false

runs.name: demo-rules
runs.cmd: mv kit/starter copperline-couriers && cp -R copperline/. copperline-couriers/ && cd copperline-couriers && npm test -- --watchAll=false src/mock-api/deliveries

runs.name: demo-all
runs.cmd: mv kit/starter copperline-couriers && cp -R copperline/. copperline-couriers/ && cd copperline-couriers && npm test -- --watchAll=false

runs.name: demo-new-status
runs.cmd: mv kit/starter copperline-couriers && cp -R copperline/. copperline-couriers/ && cd copperline-couriers && npx expo customize tsconfig.json > /dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit

runs.name: demo-no-item
runs.cmd: mv kit/starter copperline-couriers && cp -R copperline/. copperline-couriers/ && cd copperline-couriers && npx expo customize tsconfig.json > /dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit

runs.name: demo-production
runs.cmd: mv kit/starter copperline-couriers && cp -R copperline/. copperline-couriers/ && cd copperline-couriers && cp .env.example .env.local && APP_VARIANT=production npx expo config
expect: A production build needs an https:// EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL, not "demo".
